text_block_list.text: The day of the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—When she won the Shuka Sho and achieved 
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It overlapped with that massive back that 
had appeared in my dreams time and time 
again.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna. The Triple Tiara Umamusume 
who shattered both my career, which was 
supposed to be glorious, and my 
confidence... into pieces.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is, of course, a race meant for you, 
Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—Still, it is a race, after all. It's 
unthinkable that it wouldn't be for my 
sake.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because you worked so hard for me and won 
the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As an older sister, I will overcome the 
humiliation of that day, too.

The younger sister, now a Triple Tiara 
Umamusume, faces off against her elder 
sister, the former Queen of the Mile. 
Enthralled by this dramatic clash, the 
crowd—
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's really amazing. To have sisters both 
doing so well!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who's going to win...! Gotta be 
the younger sister, right? She's in her 
prime!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's a Triple Tiara Umamusume, 
right? Must be traumatizing for Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Fan
text_block_list.text:
—P-Please wait a moment...! I cannot let 
what you just said slide!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Who is that!?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Fan
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's greatest charm is without a 
doubt her indomitable spirit! Overcoming 
the nightmare of the Tiara route, she won 
back-to-back Victoria Miles.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Fan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how stoic she is, she's definitely 
gotten back to her prime condition. ...No, 
perhaps even—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Fan
text_block_list.text:
Facing a Triple Tiara Umamusume she must 
surpass, she may have grown even stronger 
than before...!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Fan
text_block_list.text:
And Vivlos too, is an Umamusume at the top 
of her game in both name and deed... This 
match is still anyone's game!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: I see...! I'm starting to get fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Such incredible excitement.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if a showdown between big sis 
and me would get this hype too."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...What are you trying to show me? Both 
of you—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haaah~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nope!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so excited for this♡

After the Nakayama Kinen, Vivlos gradually 
built up her training according to her 
physical condition. Her form looks quite 
good.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... Big sis is super 
amazing, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally confident! After all, I became 
a Triple Tiara Umamusume!
choice_data_list: Let's show them how much you've grown!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You're right!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go show big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected, Big Sis really is 
super amazing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really sure, but right now I might 
just be excited.
choice_data_list: Go out there and have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go show big sis!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Welcome, Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it feels kinda weird.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I had a feeling a day like 
this would come.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Vivlos. I won't be spoiling you today."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The Victoria Mile is my race... Precisely 
because it's you, I won't back down."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't go easy and let you catch up like 
I did when we were kids.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I love being pampered by my big sister, 
and I love pampering her, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“But... in a race, I want to be the one 
pampering Big Sis!”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to come at me with everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'll embrace every single part of it for 
you♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I'll take you up on that. I'm counting 
on you, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Let's play with all our might, Big 
Sis!
